findings.title: Retain the visual follow-up host fixture and probe recipe for exact replay
findings.evidence: The temporary wrapper is described in prose and the JSON preserves outcomes, but the handover directory contains neither its exact HTML/server fixture nor the executed DOM probe expressions. The recorded interactions and unchanged source manifest support the stated findings, but a subsequent reviewer must reconstruct the host and measurements. The repository runtime and matrix wrappers also differ (for example, the runtime wrapper adds body margin and hidden-element rules), so naming the general artifact-host approach alone does not identify exact hosting bytes.
findings.impact: Minor repeatability limitation for reproducing geometry and focus measurements in exactly the same environment; this does not invalidate the source-supported findings or prevent Claude from acting on the handover.
findings.recommendation: Preserve a small loopback host fixture and probe recipe, or record their exact code plus page routes, viewport and motion settings. If the original fixture cannot be recovered, label any replacement as a new reproduction harness rather than historical evidence.
